_leeme: Example battle for the simulator mockups (Gen 9 OU, singles, level 100). It is a fixed script: the five parts of the simulator show THIS battle, with these figures. HP is always a percentage. da = [side, Pokémon, HP before, HP after]. ef = effectiveness (4, 2, 1, 0.5, 0). prob = win probability of “yo” at the end of each turn (index 0 is before the start). The AI ratings go from 0 to 100. Images by id: official-artwork/<id>.png, showdown/<id>.gif (front) and showdown/back/<id>.gif (back); if a gif fails, it falls back to the artwork.

rival.origen: Meta team · Kyurem + Slowking-Galar + Cinderace core (44.7%)

rivales.detalle: The most defensive team in the format
Pits two of your teams against each other

notas: Kingambit has no safe answer on the opposing team if it reaches the endgame with fallen allies.
Great Tusk wins the lead matchup: Ice Spinner hits Landorus-Therian for x4.
Iron Valiant with Booster Energy outspeeds your whole team.
Choice Specs Kyurem lets nothing but Steel types switch in for free.

opciones: Rocks now, but Landorus is left untouched
